local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local FS=require(RS.Shared.FieldScene) workspace:SetAttribute('VoyageActive',true) workspace:SetAttribute('DevWeapon','fist') task.spawn(function() pcall(function() FS.start({name='카리브 해적 소굴',portId='havana',nodes=2,danger=3,seed=5,onFinish=function() end}) end) end) task.wait(3) local ch=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(3000,4,100)) local RS=game:GetService('RunService') pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep('WpCam') end) RS:BindToRenderStep('WpCam',Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+1,function() local ch=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character local h=ch and ch:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') if not h then return end local c=workspace.CurrentCamera c.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable c.FieldOfView=60 local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('FieldScene') local tgt=nil local bd=1e9 if f then for _,m in f:GetChildren() do local r=m.Name=='FieldEnemy' and m:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') if r then local d=(r.Position-h.Position).Magnitude if d<bd then bd=d tgt=r end end end end local look=if tgt then (tgt.Position-h.Position)*Vector3.new(1,0,1) else h.CFrame.LookVector if look.Magnitude<0.1 then look=Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end look=look.Unit local side=Vector3.new(-look.Z,0,look.X) c.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(h.Position-look*11+side*6+Vector3.new(0,5,0),h.Position+look*4+Vector3.new(0,2,0)) end) return 'cam'
